blocks.text: I am keeping our notes on the {{fact:f:E-2018-001.client}} shared services work in this one thread, so that the data requests and their answers stay in a single place as the design gets going, and this is just a short update from our first weeks. Jason Torres and I have made a start on the baseline, walking the finance and procurement activities unit by unit from the materials your team sent across, and the early read is the familiar one, that the work is a good deal tidier in the process notes than the people actually doing it describe it to be.

To carry the baseline into the cost picture we need two things from your side, and I have kept both as small as the work allows. The first is read access to the last two years of the support-function cost detail, and the second is thirty minutes each with the two unit finance leads you flagged as the ones who really run the day-to-day; if those introductions are easier coming from you, I am glad for the requests to go out under your name.

Whatever is quickest to send, pass it straight to me, Daniel Cisneros, and I will make sure it reaches the rest of the team the same day. I know these requests land on you, Steven Lowe, in weeks that are surely already full, and I have kept them as light as the work allows; I will hold the two sessions open in our calendars for late next week so that we are ready the moment your leads can spare the time.
